summary: PART A — PASS. (a1) Web homepage hero: /app/frontend/src/components/DualFlagshipHero.jsx lines 155-167 renders <video data-testid='hero-video' controls playsInline preload='metadata' poster='/branding/screenshots/dashboard-hero.png' src=<mp4>. Old data-testid 'hero-screenshot-img' is GONE (grep across /app/frontend/src → 0 hits). The .mp4 asset returns 200 (video/mp4, 84 MB) when curled. In the Playwright Chromium harness v.readyState=0, networkState=3, error.code=4 because the headless build lacks H.264 (canPlayType('avc1.42E01E') returned ''); canPlayType('video/mp4')='maybe' and the poster image renders fine, so real end-user browsers (Chrome/Safari/Firefox/Edge with H.264) will play it — the preview-harness error is a known codec limitation, not a code bug. (a2) Mobile donuts: logged in as cathy@example.com and loaded /statement/<id> and /invoice/<id>. '[data-testid=statement-graphics]' present (4 SVGs rendered on statement detail) and '[data-testid=invoice-graphics]' present (donut '100% PAYABLE' + 'What we found' donut rendered on invoice detail). Scanned console over login→statement→invoice flow: 0 entries matching 'transform-origin' or 'Invalid DOM property'. PART B — PARITY AUDIT (code-level + rendered diffs; no code modified).

action_items: No action required for PART A fixes — hero-video + donut transform-origin are verified clean.

PARITY FIX 1 (Classification Self-Check mobile): change ClassificationSelfCheck.tsx:26-27 options to {label:'Not sure or not yet assessed'} and {label:`Classification ${i+1}`} so they match the web select ('csc-current').

PARITY FIX 2 (Care Plan Reviewer mobile): change CarePlanReviewer.tsx:383 pill label from `Class ${c}` / 'Not set' to `Classification ${c}` / 'Choose a classification' to match the web 'cp-classification' select, OR convert the web select to 'Class N' pills if we prefer the shorter mobile naming — pick one. Also add the explicit 'Prefilled from <name>. Change these if the plan is different.' confirmation line on mobile (or drop it from web) and align the submit button label to one of 'Review my care plan' / 'Review support care plan'.

PARITY FIX 3 (Budget Calculator mobile): either add the Grandfathered cap-amount explainer paragraph on mobile ('Grandfathered participants are covered by the Home Care Package no-worse-off arrangement. Lifetime cap is $86,185.23 …') or remove it from web. Also remove the '0' placeholder on BudgetCalculatorTool.tsx:80 (lifetime-balance) — web shows an empty placeholder.
critical_code_review_comments: DualFlagshipHero.jsx hard-codes the hero video URL (HERO_VIDEO_URL, line 31). This URL points to the customer-assets CloudFront bucket and is 84 MB. Consider (a) preloading only the poster (preload='metadata' already set — good), (b) hosting a smaller/720p transcode, (c) adding a <source> fallback (webm) so Playwright/Chromium-based automation and users on codec-restricted builds still see something beyond the poster.

ProviderPriceChecker.tsx keeps initial state service='Personal care' (line 38) and immediately overwrites via /ppc/services. Harmless, but the first paint shows 'Personal Care' after titleCase; if the API fails the user is stuck on a service that may not be checkable. Consider gating the render on services.length > 0.

PART B gaps stem from independent authoring of web vs mobile tool forms: mobile authors shortened 'Classification N' to 'Class N' and compressed the prefill UX into an inline suffix instead of a separate confirmation row; the grandfathered cap-amount helper was never ported to mobile.
